name: X1 Xi Wang Sports Nutrition Drink
note: Not rated: the Chinese state's share in X1 is unknown. The X1 (犀旺) brand site says the drink was jointly launched by China Sports Industry Group and ORG (claim x1-brand-org-china-sports-ownership). China Sports Industry Group's ultimate controller is the General Administration of Sport of China, whose units are its first, second and fourth largest shareholders (claim china-sports-industry-state-ownership), and China has a record on file (claim china-xinjiang-un-assessment). ORG calls 犀旺 its own brand; its 2025 annual report lists Shanghai Xiwang Beverage Co., Ltd. among the companies controlled by ORG's non-state controlling shareholder, Shanghai Yuanlong (Zhou Yunjie) (claim x1-shanghai-xiwang-yuanlong-control). AJA names James Zhou as ORG Packaging's owner and its board chairman (claim x1-aja-james-zhou-ownership). Missing: the shareholding of the business behind X1 (the joint venture, or Shanghai Xiwang Beverage): whether China Sports Industry Group holds a stake, how much, and whether it has a board seat. Under METHOD.md a state with a record counts if it controls the sponsor, holds 5% or more along the chain, or has a board seat; the tier is for a maintainer once that is sourced.
